name: Postlane – Canada — Vancouver
description:
Find real marketing, advertising, digital, creative, media, and branding agencies in Canada that could benefit from Postlane.

Postlane is a local-first marketing workspace for freelancers, agencies, and small teams. It brings together brand management, Instagram content creation, lead research, email outreach, and agency workload management in one place.

The goal is to identify agencies that manage client brands or their own marketing operations and would benefit from a single workspace for content, outreach, and team delivery.
researchInstructions:
Find real operating marketing and creative agencies in Canada. One real agency = one prospect. Merge duplicates from different sources.

Priority markets (in order): Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Edmonton, Ottawa. Also cover when capacity allows: Mississauga, Quebec City, Winnipeg, Hamilton.

Search by city/metro only. Do not run one undifferentiated nationwide search.

Target agency types only: marketing agencies, advertising agencies, digital agencies, digital marketing agencies, creative agencies, media agencies, branding agencies, social media agencies, graphic design agencies, and public relations / PR agencies that deliver marketing services to clients.

Prioritize agencies with evidence of: client brand work, social media management, content creation, campaign delivery, creative production, paid media, or multi-person marketing teams.

Contact methods: Email preferred. Prefer official agency email, info@, hello@, contact@, founders, owners, managing directors, agency principals, and business development contacts. Do not guess emails. Do not use private personal contacts unless clearly published as official agency contacts.

Excluded (LOW qualify / reject): travel agencies, real estate agencies, recruitment / staffing / employment agencies, insurance agencies, government offices, freelancers with no agency presence, software vendors selling only tools, directories and lead lists, schools, restaurants, clinics, hotels, and unrelated professional services.

Every prospect MUST have at least one source URL proving it is an actual agency (official website, contact page, portfolio, agency directory listing with website). Never invent agency name, website, email, phone, contact name, or job title. Leave unverified fields empty.

Qualification: High (80%+) for established marketing/advertising/digital/creative agencies with client work and a clear team or service offering. Medium for smaller but real agencies with a website and marketing services. Low for travel/real-estate/recruitment agencies, directories, solo freelancers without agency branding, or no evidence of marketing services. Minimum qualification target: 75%.

Outreach goal: introduce Postlane to agency owners, founders, managing directors, and marketing leaders for a short demo of social media workflows, lead research, email campaigns, brand management, and agency delivery tools.
